about.title: About
about.description.title: Project
about.description.text: A local-first Chrome extension that automates TradingView strategy input testing, stores every result, and helps you compare stronger parameter regions.
about.local.title: Your reports stay local
about.local.text: Optimization settings and reports are stored in Chrome local storage. This build does not require an analytics or report server.
about.risk.title: Use responsibly
about.risk.text: TradingView is not affiliated with this project. Automated page interactions may be restricted by its terms or rate limits.
